units.source_text: 但薰君不欲公开地由侍女说合。

en.t: But Lord Kaoru did not wish to have the maidservants arrange the matter openly.

units.source_text: 他原来就准备悄悄地进行，使外人不辨何时开始，自然而然地成就好事。

en.t: He had intended from the beginning to proceed quietly, so that outsiders would not know when it had begun and the happy matter would come about naturally.

units.source_text: 所以他叫人对大女公子说：“如果小姐不允许，今后永远保持如此关系可也。”

en.t: So he had someone tell the elder lady, If you do not permit it, I am willing to keep our relationship just as it is forever.

units.source_text: 但弁君同几个老婆子私下商谈，意欲公开地玉成其事。

en.t: But Ben no Kimi privately consulted with several old women and meant to bring the matter openly to a successful conclusion.

units.source_text: 这虽是出于好心，但恐是思虑浅薄之故，或者老年昏聩之故，大女公子非常讨厌她们。

en.t: Although this came from good intentions, whether because their thinking was shallow or because old age had clouded their judgment, the elder lady disliked them intensely.

units.source_text: 弁君来时，大女公子对她说：“父亲在世之时，多年之间，常常称道薰中纳言对我家之亲切与众不同。

en.t: When Ben no Kimi came, the elder lady said to her, While my father was alive, for many years he often praised Middle Counselor Kaoru's exceptional kindness toward our house.

units.source_text: 现在父亲去世之后，我家万事全赖他竭诚相助。

en.t: Now that my father is gone, our household depends entirely on his wholehearted assistance in every matter.

units.source_text: 想不到他忽然起了求爱之心，常常申恨诉怨，实在讨厌得很。

en.t: I never imagined that he would suddenly develop feelings of love and constantly voice grievances and complaints; it is truly most unpleasant.

units.source_text: 我倘是随顺世俗、愿意婚嫁的人，那么他提出这样的要求，怎么会不接受呢？

en.t: If I were the sort of person who followed worldly custom and wished to marry, how could I fail to accept such a proposal from him?

units.source_text: 可是我自昔就断绝世俗之念，誓愿独身到底，因此非常痛苦。

en.t: But long ago I cut off all worldly thoughts and vowed to remain unmarried to the end, and so this causes me great pain.

units.source_text: 惟有我的妹妹，虚度青春，未免可惜。

en.t: Only my younger sister's case troubles me, for it would be a pity if she wasted her youth.

units.source_text: 实在，只有为妹妹的将来着想，这孤居寂处的生活才是不适宜的。

en.t: Indeed, only when I think of my sister's future does this lonely, secluded life seem unsuitable.

units.source_text: 倘薰中纳言果真不忘父亲旧情，但愿他对妹妹和对我一样看待。

en.t: If Middle Counselor Kaoru truly has not forgotten his old ties with my father, I hope he will regard my sister just as he regards me.

units.source_text: 她是我的同胞手足，我真心情愿把一切都让给她。

en.t: She is my own flesh and blood, and I sincerely wish to yield everything to her.

units.source_text: 希望你转达此意，善为说辞。”

en.t: I hope you will convey this meaning and explain it well for me.

units.source_text: 她羞涩地把心中欲说的话如实告诉了弁君。

en.t: Shyly, she told Ben no Kimi plainly what she had wanted to say in her heart.

units.source_text: 弁君深感同情，答道：“我以前早就察知大小姐怀着此种心情，曾经详细地对中纳言谈过。

en.t: Ben no Kimi felt deep sympathy and replied, I had long since perceived that you felt this way, my lady, and once spoke of it in detail to the Middle Counselor.

units.source_text: 但他说：‘要我如此转变念头，是不可能的。

en.t: But he said, It is impossible for me to change my mind in that way.

units.source_text: 况且兵部卿亲王近来恋慕之心更切，二小姐应该和他结缘，我自当尽力玉成。’

en.t: Besides, the Prince Minister of War has lately grown still more ardent in his affection, so the younger lady ought to be joined with him, and I shall do all I can to help it succeed.

units.source_text: 这也是合乎理想之事。

en.t: That too would be an ideal outcome.

units.source_text: 即使是父母俱存、悉心抚育长成的千金小姐，倘两人都能结成如此美满的姻缘，也是世间不易多得之事。

en.t: Even for noble daughters whose parents are both alive and who have been raised with the utmost care, it is rare in this world for both sisters to make such fortunate marriages.

units.source_text: 恕我直说：我看了这衰败零落之状，常常担心两位小姐将来结果如何，不胜悲伤。

en.t: Forgive me for speaking plainly, but when I see this fallen and desolate state, I am always worried about what will become of you two ladies and am overwhelmed with sadness.

units.source_text: 人心日后是否会变，虽然不得而知，但无论如何，这总是美满的宿世姻缘。

en.t: Although no one can know whether people's hearts may change in the future, in any case this is surely a fortunate bond from a former life.

units.source_text: 小姐不肯违背亲王遗言，原是正理。

en.t: It is of course right that you do not wish to go against the late prince's words.

units.source_text: 但亲王之所以有此诫告，乃因恐怕没有适当人物而与品性不端之人结缘。

en.t: But the reason the prince gave that warning was that he feared you might find no suitable person and be joined to someone of poor character.

units.source_text: 他屡次说过：‘这薰君如果有意求婚，那么我家一人有了着落，便可放心，此乃何等可喜之事。’

en.t: He often said, If this Lord Kaoru were to seek marriage, then one person in our house would be settled and I could be at ease; how very pleasing that would be.

units.source_text: 凡是失去慈亲的女子，不论贵贱，由于意外之变而和身份不称的人结婚，世间不乏其例。

en.t: Among women who have lost loving parents, whether highborn or lowborn, the world has many examples of those who, through unexpected turns, marry people unsuited to their rank.

units.source_text: 这都是寻常之事，不会有人讥笑。

en.t: Such things are common, and no one would ridicule them.

units.source_text: 何况薰中纳言的身份与人品，竟像特地定制的一般。

en.t: How much more so when Middle Counselor Kaoru's rank and character seem as though they were specially made for you.

units.source_text: 如此诚心诚意地前来求婚，岂可怫然置之不理而一意孤行地遵守亲王遗言，埋头修行佛道呢？

en.t: When he comes to propose with such sincerity, how can you coldly ignore him, stubbornly cling only to the prince's last words, and bury yourself in Buddhist practice?

units.source_text: 难道真能像神仙一般以云霞为粮食么？”

en.t: Can you truly live like an immortal, feeding on clouds and mist?

units.source_text: 她滔滔不绝地说了一大篇，大女公子非常讨厌，懊恼之极，只是横卧着，不答一语。

en.t: She poured out this long speech without pause, and the elder lady, finding it deeply distasteful and feeling utterly distressed, merely lay on her side and did not answer a word.
